items.v:
Cataracts develop when the eye’s natural lens becomes cloudy, often due to age or other factors. This leads to blurred vision, increased sensitivity to light, and difficulty performing everyday tasks. If left untreated, cataracts can severely impact quality of life.
At OPTIMAX Eye Specialist, we approach cataract treatment with precision, compassion, and decades of clinical expertise. Our mission is to restore your vision through safe, evidence-based methods that prioritize your comfort and long-term clarity.

v: Senior ophthalmologists with extensive cataract experience

sections.heading: The OPTIMAX Approach – Femtosecond Laser-Assisted Cataract Surgery (FLACS)

items.v:
What is FLACS?
FLACS stands for Femtosecond Laser-Assisted Cataract Surgery, a bladeless, computer-guided method that improves the precision and predictability of cataract removal.
Our Technology: The Z8 Laser System
At OPTIMAX, we use the Ziemer Z8 femtosecond laser, one of the most advanced platforms globally.

sections.heading: The Procedure in Detail
intro: Every FLACS procedure at OPTIMAX follows a highly structured and controlled process:

items.title: Corneal Incision
items.text: A laser creates a precise entry point with minimal disruption.

items.title: Capsulotomy
items.text: The laser forms a perfectly centered opening in the lens capsule.

items.title: Lens Fragmentation
items.text: The cataract is gently broken down with laser pulses, requiring less ultrasound energy.

items.title: Lens Removal & IOL Implantation
items.text: The cloudy lens is removed and replaced with an artificial intraocular lens (IOL).

note: Note: All surgeries are performed under local anaesthesia without the need for injections. However, general anaesthesia is also available upon request or if medically required. Each step is monitored in real-time to ensure optimal safety and surgical performance.

sections.heading: Intraocular Lens (IOL) Options
intro: After cataract removal, your vision is restored using a medical-grade artificial lens. At OPTIMAX, we offer:

cards.title: Monofocal IOL
items: Glasses may be needed for reading

cards.title: Trifocal / Multifocal IOL
items: Corrects near, intermediate, and far vision

note: Simulations and lens counseling are provided during your consultation so you can make an informed choice.
